sources.note: Old fundingRate history URL redirects to unified official REST catalog. Actual funding records/time/mark prices are from the saved public GET responses; never infer an eight-hour schedule.
Spot archives from 2025 use microseconds; USD-M REST/archive units separately validated in actual data provenance. Existing data hashes/time units checked; no new SMA daily download.

Exponential decay reference only. This frozen engine uses custom finite normalized S16 support, beta15/17 and lagD3, with strict absolute hurdle; no claim ordinary unbounded pandas EWM equals the finite rule.
